biotools.summary: LoVis4u is a command-line tool and Python API for fast and customizable visualization of genomic loci, generating publication-ready vector images based on GenBank or GFF files. It is designed for comparative genomic analysis and can be used to highlight accessory and core genes.
biotools.name: LoVis4u
